name: Summer PreCollege Intensive
org: Pratt Institute (School of Continuing and Professional Studies)
what_you_do: Take two college classes in art, design, architecture or writing for four weeks, build a portfolio and earn 4 college credits. Live on campus and show your work in an exhibition.
who_can_apply: High school students who will be between 15.5 and 18 years old. U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or international students with a valid F-1 visa. All experience levels are welcome.
pay_detail: Costs money. The tuition amount was not on the pages we read. Budget $300 to $500 more for art supplies, plus metro fare. Need-based scholarships cover tuition, program fees, housing and meal plan.
duration: 4 weeks, 4 college credits. 2027 dates: check-in Tue, July 6; classes July 8 to July 30; exhibition and move out Sat, July 31.
deadline_text: Not open yet: applications for Summer 2027 open in November (no day or year given). Scholarship application deadline Feb 1, 2027. International student deadline Apr 1, 2027. Payment due May 31, 2027. The main application deadline is not stated.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the Pratt PreCollege form. It opens in November. Students are billed in mid-April and payment is due right away. Scholarship forms are separate. Email: precollege@pratt.edu (listed on the page).
notes: Scholarships go to students with strong art work and big money need. The FAQ says winners usually come from homes with income of $60,000 or less. Pratt also has shorter options. They include an Explore program, an online summer program, Saturday classes and one-day workshops.
